capabilities.label: HTTP/network client access
capabilities.description: Can use HTTP or web-client APIs to communicate with external services.

capabilities.label: Outbound network access
capabilities.description: References networking namespaces or APIs that can make outbound connections.

capabilities.label: Raw socket access
capabilities.description: Can open TCP, UDP, or other socket connections.

capabilities.label: Local/network listener
capabilities.description: Can listen for inbound local or network connections.

capabilities.label: Filesystem read access
capabilities.description: Can read files or enumerate directories.

capabilities.label: Filesystem write access
capabilities.description: Can create or modify files and directories.

capabilities.label: Filesystem delete access
capabilities.description: Can delete files or directories.

capabilities.label: Hard-coded external path access
capabilities.description: Contains absolute filesystem paths outside known FFXIV/Dalamud locations together with file-access capability.

capabilities.label: External process execution
capabilities.description: Can launch another executable, process, or shell command.

capabilities.label: Process inspection
capabilities.description: Can inspect process information using diagnostics/process APIs.

capabilities.label: Shell or PowerShell invocation
capabilities.description: Can invoke command shells or PowerShell functionality.

capabilities.label: Windows Registry access
capabilities.description: Can read or modify the Windows Registry.

capabilities.label: Native interoperability
capabilities.description: Uses P/Invoke, native libraries, or native interop mechanisms.

capabilities.label: Writable and executable native section
capabilities.description: A native PE section is both writable and executable.

capabilities.label: Dynamic code or assembly loading
capabilities.description: Can load or generate code dynamically at runtime.

capabilities.label: Cross-process memory access
capabilities.description: Can open another process or read/write its memory.

capabilities.label: Remote thread creation
capabilities.description: Can create or queue execution in another process.

capabilities.label: Clipboard access
capabilities.description: Can read or modify clipboard contents.

capabilities.label: Credential or protected-data access
capabilities.description: Can access credential-manager, password-vault, or protected-data APIs.

capabilities.label: Game state read access
capabilities.description: Can inspect Dalamud-exposed game/client state.

capabilities.label: Game input/key state read access
capabilities.description: Can inspect key or input state exposed by Dalamud.

capabilities.label: Game chat read access
capabilities.description: Can receive or inspect game chat data exposed by Dalamud.

capabilities.label: Game UI read access
capabilities.description: Can inspect game UI/addon state.

capabilities.label: Game memory/signature access
capabilities.description: Uses signature scanning, client structures, hooks, or related game-memory facilities.

capabilities.label: Game UI callback/control
capabilities.description: Can invoke game addon callbacks or event mechanisms.

capabilities.label: Synthetic game UI interaction
capabilities.description: Can synthesize clicks or selections in game UI dialogs.

capabilities.label: Inventory UI/control
capabilities.description: Can invoke inventory-mutating or inventory-action functionality.

capabilities.label: Vendor/shop automation
capabilities.description: Can invoke vendor/shop functionality capable of buying or selling items.

capabilities.label: Retainer automation
capabilities.description: Can invoke retainer-management functionality.

capabilities.label: Character target control
capabilities.description: Can change the player character's target or focus target.

capabilities.label: Character action execution
capabilities.description: Can invoke game action APIs capable of combat, crafting, gathering, or other character actions.

capabilities.label: World/NPC interaction control
capabilities.description: Can activate or interact with NPCs, objects, or world targets.

capabilities.label: Teleport/travel control
capabilities.description: Can invoke teleport or travel-control functionality.

capabilities.label: Character movement control
capabilities.description: Can invoke movement or navigation functionality capable of moving the player character.

capabilities.label: Camera control
capabilities.description: Can mutate game camera state.

capabilities.label: Keyboard input injection
capabilities.description: Can synthesize keyboard input through native APIs.

capabilities.label: Mouse input injection
capabilities.description: Can synthesize mouse input through native APIs.

capabilities.label: Indirect automation via IPC
capabilities.description: Consumes IPC functionality associated with automation supplied by another plugin.

capabilities.label: Bundled executable
capabilities.description: The plugin package contains one or more executable files.

capabilities.label: Download/execute potential
capabilities.description: Static evidence contains both network/download and execution-related capability.
